name: High Arcana
description: An archmage gains one high arcana ability per level, chosen from the list below. Each ability trades one prepared spell slot of the indicated level for a permanent special ability.

options.name: Arcane Fire
options.description: Change arcane spell energy into arcane fire, dealing 1d6 damage per spell level plus 1d6 per caster level (as a ranged touch attack). Costs one 9th-level spell slot.

ability.name: Arcane Fire
ability.description: Change arcane spell energy into arcane fire, dealing 1d6 damage per spell level plus 1d6 per caster level as a ranged touch attack.

options.name: Arcane Reach
options.description: Use touch spells as ranged touch attacks with a range of 30 feet. Costs one 7th-level spell slot.

ability.name: Arcane Reach
ability.description: Use touch-range spells as ranged touch attacks with a range of 30 feet.

options.name: Improved Arcane Reach
options.description: Arcane reach extends to 60 feet. Requires Arcane Reach. Costs one 7th-level spell slot.

options.name: Mastery of Counterspelling
options.description: When you successfully counterspell a spell, it is reflected back at the caster. Costs one 7th-level spell slot.

ability.name: Mastery of Counterspelling
ability.description: When you successfully counterspell a spell, it is turned back upon the caster as if it were fully combated by a spell turning spell.

options.name: Mastery of Elements
options.description: Alter an arcane spell with an energy descriptor to use a different energy type. Costs one 8th-level spell slot.

ability.name: Mastery of Elements
ability.description: Alter an arcane spell with an energy descriptor to use a different type of energy (acid, cold, electricity, or fire).

options.name: Mastery of Shaping
options.description: Alter area and effect spells that use one of the standard shapes to create spaces within the area that are not subject to the spell. Costs one 6th-level spell slot.

ability.name: Mastery of Shaping
ability.description: Alter area and effect spells that use a standard shape (burst, cone, cylinder, emanation, or spread) to exclude any number of 5-foot squares from the area.

options.name: Spell Power
options.description: +1 to caster level for the purpose of level-dependent spell effects. May be selected multiple times. Costs one 5th-level spell slot.

ability.name: Spell Power
ability.description: +1 to caster level for the purpose of determining level-dependent spell variables and for caster level checks.

options.name: Spell-Like Ability
options.description: Use a spell of 5th level or lower as a spell-like ability twice per day. Costs one spell slot one level higher than the chosen spell.

ability.name: Spell-Like Ability
ability.description: Use a spell of 5th level or lower as a spell-like ability twice per day.
